SHIP GEOMETRY ATTRIBUTION
Star Citizen ship designs and RSI holoviewer geometry: Cloud Imperium Games
and its respective rights holders. All respective rights remain with them.
Voyager is a fan-made stream overlay and is not an official CIG product.
These public website-viewer meshes are not offered as full game assets.

Local rendering adaptation: orientation, scale normalisation, duplicate-face
cleanup, rebuilt normals, Voyager materials and engine/weapon effect mounts.
Original CTM downloads are bundled unchanged. Retrieved 21 October 2026.
